subject: MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (draft) - MedCorp Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@medcorp.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (draft)

Hi Olivia / MedCorp team,

Thanks again for the call earlier - great conversation and appreciate the level of detail on your PHI handling requirements. Per our agreement on the call, I drafted the MAP milestone specific to data handling & compliance for the POC / pilot phase. Please find the milestone below (draft) and call out anything missing or any blockers from your side.

MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (POC) - draft
- Target owner: Redwood (technical) + MedCorp (data & legal)
- Target close date: 2026-08-15 (tentative)
- Objectives: confirm acceptable data flows for PHI/PII, finalize retention & logging policy, sign BAA, agree on audit evidence delivery cadence
- Responsibilities:
  - Redwood: provide data flow diagram; confirm encryption in transit + at rest; enable per-tenant audit logs (access, request metadata, storage events); provide SOC 2 summary and relevant controls; document model output retention policy and redaction options
  - MedCorp: classify data used in POC, indicate fields considered PHI/PII, decide whether outputs will contain PHI (if yes, require stricter retention/erasure), review & approve BAA language, provide contact for audit/evidence requests
- Retention constraints (draft):
  - Request/Prompt logging: default 30 days for full content; configurable with stricter limits (e.g., 0-7 days) for PHI-marked workflows
  - Model outputs: do not persist by default for PHI workflows; can persist for non-PHI with 90-day retention unless otherwise agreed
  - Audit logs (access/auth/events): retained 1 year (encrypted, immutable storage) unless contractually extended
- Audit/logging: provide per-request metadata (request id, timestamp, user id, route/model) and administrator access logs; support export of audit records on 30-day cadence or ad-hoc requests with SLA
- Dependencies: BAA execution, legal sign-off on retention limits, SOC 2 evidence package review, confirmation of telemetry redaction process
- Success criteria: BAA signed, MedCorp confirms PHI classification + retention limits, SOC2 evidence delivered, POC proceeds without blocked data-handling items

Attachments: I uploaded the MAP spreadsheet for us to track milestones (MedCorp_MAP_v2.xlsx). Dev will follow up with a short data-flow diagram and SOC2 summary.

Next steps:
1) Olivia / MedCorp: review the draft retention lines above and mark any items that are unacceptable by EOD Wednesday (2026-07-29).
2) Redwood (Dev): share data flow diagram + SOC2 summary in thread (by 2026-07-29).
3) Both legal teams: review BAA (we will share DocuSign link once internal redlines are complete).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (draft)

Hi all - adding a few technical clarifications to the MAP draft and attaching the artifacts I mentioned.

Key clarifications:
- We support per-tenant KMS keying (customer-managed keys) for data at rest; we can point MedCorp to our KMS integration guide and KMS roles for the pilot.
- Telemetry & request logs: by default we capture full request payloads for 30 days for troubleshooting; for PHI workflows we can enable a strict mode (payload redaction + 0-day retention) or stream logs to MedCorp's tenant-only S3 bucket (encrypted) per contractual arrangement.
- Model outputs: we have a config flag to avoid persisting model outputs entirely for specific routes; alternative is token-level redaction rules (we can demo).
- Audit export: audit records are exportable as newline-delimited JSON, with filter by time range and request id. We can provide an S3 export or API access.

Attachments (uploaded): redwood-data-flow-diagram.png, SOC2-Summary.pdf

If MedCorp wants, we can schedule a short technical session next week to walk the actual data flow and where redaction would happen.

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@medcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: MedCorp Security Team <security@medcorp.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 13:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (draft)

Marissa / Dev - thanks for the detailed draft. A few clarifying questions from our side so we can confirm internally:

1) Retention defaults: 30 days for requests is workable for non-PHI, but for PHI workflows we need the option for 0-day retention + immediate erasure. Can you confirm the erasure process is irreversible and provide SLAs for erasure?
2) Model outputs: MedCorp policy is to avoid persisting PHI in downstream systems. Can you confirm you will not persist outputs for any PHI-marked route unless explicitly enabled by us?
3) Audit trail granularity: we need per-request user-id and originating IP, plus any admin access events. Can you confirm these fields are present in the audit export?
4) BAA: please share a redlined BAA for our counsel or a DocuSign link.

We will aim to respond with any redlines to the retention language by end of day Thursday (2026-07-30). Also looping in our security contact in case they want to join the technical session.

Regards,
Olivia Chen
Head of Product Partnerships, MedCorp Health
olivia.chen@medcorp.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@medcorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (draft)

Thanks Olivia - good questions. Quick update and proposed revised MAP timeline given legal/counsel availability:

Updates / confirmations:
- Erasure: Redwood supports an irreversible erasure request for stored request payloads and model outputs; for the pilot we will document the erasure process and include an SLA of 72 hours for request-based erasure (subject to BAA terms).
- Model outputs: we will not persist outputs for PHI-marked routes by default. Persistence must be explicitly enabled by MedCorp via configuration or an API flag.
- Audit export: the audit records include request id, timestamp, user id (if provided), originating IP, model/version, and admin access events. These fields are available in the export.

Revised MAP milestone dates (proposal):
- Target close date (BAA signed + retention policy agreed): 2026-08-18 (push 3 business days to allow counsel review)
- Technical session requested: week of 2026-08-02 - Dev to propose 2 slots
- Redwood deliverables: SOC2 summary + data flow diagram (done), export of initial audit sample (by 2026-08-05)
- MedCorp deliverables: BAA redlines submitted (by 2026-08-11), PHI field spec for POC (by 2026-08-11)

HubSpot: updated deal RC-78910 with MAP milestone and tasks. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/RC-78910
